title: Influence of Metal Fragment Mobility and Solution Dynamics on Cationic Rearrangements in Multimetallic Alkoxide Frameworks

material_class.structural_family: iodide-bridged dimer of CdCe2 alkoxide triangles

synthesis.procedure: Under nitrogen, 5.49 mL (2.81 mmol) of an isopropanolic KOPri solution (0.02 g potassium/mL) was added to 2.45 g (2.81 mmol) [Ce(OPri)4(HOPri)]2 in 10 mL toluene. After stirring for 1 h, the solvent was removed at 10^-3 mbar. The yellow solid was dissolved in 10 mL toluene and reacted with 1.03 g CdI2 suspended in toluene. After 12 h at room temperature, the yellow solution was decanted from the precipitate and volatiles were removed at 10^-3 mbar, giving a light yellow solid.

synthesis.vessel_or_method: nitrogen atmosphere, modified Stock vacuum line; salt elimination
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: Decant from the precipitate and remove volatiles under reduced pressure (10^-3 mbar); isolated as a light yellow solid.

material_class.structural_family: iodide-bridged dimer of BaCe2 alkoxide triangles

synthesis.procedure: Under nitrogen, 2.23 g (2.56 mmol) [Ce(OPri)4(PriOH)]2 was dissolved in 10 mL toluene and 10 mL heptane, and 5 mL (2.56 mmol) of an isopropanolic KOPri solution (0.02 g potassium/mL) was added. After 1 h at room temperature, the solvent was removed at 10^-3 mbar. The yellow solid was redissolved in 10 mL toluene and 10 mL heptane and added to 1 g (2.56 mmol) BaI2 suspended in 5 mL THF. After 16 h at room temperature, the yellow solution was decanted from the white precipitate and volatiles were removed at 10^-3 mbar.

material_class.structural_family: centrosymmetric dimer with a Cd2(OPri)2 ring and Sr in the Ce2(OPri)9 pocket

synthesis.procedure: Under nitrogen, 0.27 g (1.29 mmol) Sr(OPri)2 was dissolved in toluene and 5.07 mL (1.30 mmol) of an isopropanolic KOPri solution (0.01 g potassium/mL) was added. After 1 h at 80 °C, volatiles were removed at 10^-3 mbar. The colorless solid was dissolved in toluene and slowly added to a toluene solution of 1.36 g (1.29 mmol) [ICd{Ce2(OPri)9}]2. After 12 h at room temperature, the solution was decanted from the precipitate and volatiles were removed at 10^-3 mbar, giving a light yellow solid. The solid-state structure shows Sr/Cd rearrangement relative to the starting fragments.

material_class.structural_family: centrosymmetric dimer with a Cd2(OPri)2 ring and Ba in the Ce2(OPri)9 pocket

synthesis.procedure: Method A: under nitrogen, 1.17 g (2.70 mmol) [Cd{N(SiMe3)2}2] in 15 mL toluene was reacted with 10.6 mL (2.70 mmol) of an isopropanolic KOPri solution (0.01 g potassium/mL) at 60 °C for 1 h. Volatiles were removed and the residue was dissolved in 5 mL toluene and 5 mL heptane. Separately, [IBa{Ce2(OPri)9}]2 was prepared as for compound 2 starting from 2.36 g (2.70 mmol) [Ce(OPri)4(PriOH)]2 and stirred with the in situ [K{Cd(OPri)3}] for 16 h at room temperature. After decanting KI and removing volatiles, a yellow solid was obtained. Yield: 3.05 g (2.46 mmol, 91%). Method B: 0.26 g (1.02 mmol) Ba(OPri)2 in toluene was treated with 3.86 mL (0.99 mmol) of an isopropanolic KOPri solution (0.01 g potassium/mL), stirred 1 h at 80 °C, and evaporated at 10^-3 mbar. The colorless solid in toluene was added to 1.04 g (0.99 mmol) [ICd{Ce2(OPri)9}]2 in toluene, stirred 12 h at room temperature, decanted, and evaporated at 10^-3 mbar. Yield: 1.15 g (0.93 mmol, 94%). Route B involves Cd/Ba rearrangement; route A places Ba directly in the alkoxocerate pocket.

material_class.structural_family: monomeric heterotrimetallic alkoxide; seven-coordinate Ba chelated by Ce2(OPri)9 and Al(OPri)4 plus HOPri

synthesis.procedure: Under nitrogen, [IBa{Ce2(OPri)9}]2 was prepared as for compound 2 at the 2.56 mmol scale, without decanting the precipitate. Then 0.77 g (2.56 mmol) [K{Al(OPri)4}] in 5 mL toluene and 5 mL isopropyl alcohol was added to the in situ bimetallic mixture. After 16 h at room temperature, the yellow solution was decanted from the KI precipitates of both salt eliminations. Removal of volatiles gave a yellow-orange viscous oil that slowly crystallized at -18 °C as light yellow rhombi.
